drafts.walkScript: Start with the word “cup”. Add “board” and you get cupboard, one real word. Cupplate and cupspoon are not words. Plates and spoons go with cups, but they do not join.
Start with the word “grand”. Add “mother” and you get grandmother, one real word. Grandhouse and grandold are not words. So house and old do not join with grand.
Start with the word “sea”. Add “weed” and you get seaweed, one real word. Seasand and seawave are not words. Sand and wave belong at the beach, but they do not join.
Start with the word “farm”. Add “yard” and you get farmyard, one real word. Farmfield and farmbarn are not words. Field and barn belong on a farm, but they do not join.
